QuestInfo.name: I'm Bored 1
QuestInfo.0: I should go see Icarus, who's at the top of a building in Kerning City. He seems to be bored out of his mind.
QuestInfo.1: I got to talk to Icarus of Kerning City. Just what exactly is he doing staring aimlessly at the sky anyway? He seemed to be really bored, and asked me if I can answer his set of questions.
QuestInfo.2: I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.

0.0: Man, soooo boring. Hey, you! Do you have any free time right now? Do you wanna hang out with me? I'm really bored out of my mind here.

yes.0: Alright! Thanks... now, what should we do? How about... I know, why don't I quiz you on some things? They aren't going to be hard at all, so don't worry about it. Are you down with it?

no.0: Oh you're busy... I'm really bored, though. Don't you wanna hang out with me?
